items.title: Missouri media organizations sue highway patrol over redacted crash reports
items.summary: Four media organizations, including the Missouri Broadcasters Association and the Missouri Press Association, have sued the Missouri State Highway Patrol. They claim the patrol's crash reports are being released with redactions. The excerpt available for this briefing was cut off, so the full claims were not read.

items.title: Truck Overturns in Kansas City, Spilling Cattle Onto Streets
items.summary: A semitrailer plunged off a highway overpass in downtown Kansas City, Missouri, early Sunday and landed on a car, spilling dozens of cattle onto a street. Some roads were shut down. The excerpt available for this briefing was cut off, so injuries and cause were not read.
